label: Meta Ads
purpose: Daily spend, delivery, and Meta-attributed purchases per campaign, so revenue the tracker saw can be read against what the campaign cost and what Meta claims.
data: One row per day and campaign from the ad account. spend is in the account currency. purchases and purchase_value are Meta's own attribution (its window, its identity), not orders the tracker matched.

spend.label: Meta spend
spend.data: Ad spend summed over the period's days, in the account currency.

impressions.label: Meta impressions
impressions.data: Impressions summed over the period's days.

clicks.label: Meta link clicks
clicks.data: Link clicks summed over the period's days.

purchases.label: Meta-attributed purchases
purchases.data: Purchases Meta attributes to the campaign, summed over the period's days.

purchase_value.label: Meta-attributed purchase value
purchase_value.data: Purchase value Meta attributes to the campaign, summed over the period's days.
